title: Flowey The Dandelion
description: Flowey themed dandelion and wither rose textures.
body:
# Undertale: The Flowers of the Underground

A simple resource pack that brings the most iconic characters from Undertale into your Minecraft world through its flowers. Watch your step, because not every flower is as friendly as it looks!
Features

- The standard Dandelion has been replaced with the original sprite of Flowey the Flower. He's hiding in plain sight!

- The Wither Rose now features Flowey's "evil/distorted" face, perfectly matching its withered and dangerous nature.

- Includes custom Undertale-themed splash texts for the main menu to keep you determined.

# How to Install

1. Download the .zip file.

2. Open Minecraft and go to Options > Resource Packs.

3. Click Open Pack Folder.

4. Drag and drop the downloaded file into the folder.

5. Select the pack in-game and you are ready to go!

# Technical Details

- Compatibility: Designed for Minecraft 1.13 to 26.1 for now.
    
- Style: Uses original pixel art sprites to maintain the authentic Undertale feel.

    __“Don't you have anything better to do?”__
